content.title: Alcoa Stock Rises After Company Says Aluminum Pricing Is Offsetting Tariffs
content.summary: Shares of Alcoa were higher Thursday, a day after the company posted higher third-quarter sales and profit, and said that the delivery fee buyers pay for its aluminum from Canada is now more than offsetting tariff rates.  The company said the Midwest Premium, an additional cost added to the base price of aluminum delivered to the Midwest U.S., is now at 84 cents per pound of aluminum, which is covering the cost of the U.S.'s 50% tariff on aluminum imports.

content.title: FCX, Alcoa Rise As Copper, Aluminum Prices Heat Up
content.summary: Freeport-McMoRan cleared third-quarter earnings estimates early Thursday but offered no timeline for restarting production after its Grasberg mine disaster.  FCX stock rose, as the near-term copper contract rose toward the top of its recent trading range.  Meanwhile, Alcoa jumped amid a surge in aluminum prices after posting slightly better-than-forecast results late Wednesday.
